scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text:
Greetings young warrior, I'm the Exorcist Master Fahae.
I have been tracking the elusive Bacsojin for some time.

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text:
I feel it is time I let another warrior try to complete
my quest. I have some items to assist you in my quest.

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text: I have 2 items which might become useful to you.

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text:
How many do you require?
You may only buy 5 at one time.
Each costs 20000z.
(Type in 0 to cancel)

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text: Here you go, I hope you may succeed in my quest.

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text: You must not be stingy, it is the path of God to be honest.

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text: The path of fully vanquishing evil is far, help me in the way of God.

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text:
How many do you require?
You may only buy 5 at one time.
Each costs 10000z.
(Type in 0 to cancel)

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text: Here you go, I hope you may succeed in my quest.

scripts.speaker: Exorcist Master Fahae
scripts.text: Money doesn't bring joy to everyone, but we need it to support the temple and myself. Please, try to kill some monsters and take their drops.
